messages.content: I need the Cleveland expenses reconciled. I have the original $574 airfare receipt, the reissued itinerary showing no additional collection, a $514.65 hotel folio with a $32 restaurant charge I paid personally, $96 in rideshares, and a $27 meal during the connection. One ride only has the card charge and pickup time.

The reissued itinerary supports the exchange but adds $0, so claim the airfare once at $574. The business hotel amount is $482.65 after removing the $32 personal restaurant charge. With $96 in rideshares and the $27 connection meal, the reimbursable total is $1,179.65.
How should I document the ride with the incomplete receipt?

Attach the card-charge record and note the pickup time, trip purpose, and that the itemized rideshare receipt was unavailable. Add a missing-receipt statement if your expense system requires one. Submit: airfare $574, hotel $482.65, ground transportation $96, and meal $27, totaling $1,179.65. Keep the reissued itinerary attached to show there was no second airfare charge.
